title: Benefits of inhalation of 7% hypertonic saline solution prior to ELTGOL physiotherapy, in patients with bronchiectasis. A randomized controlled trial.
official: Benefits of inhalation of 7% hypertonic saline solution prior to ELTGOL physiotherapy, in patients with bronchiectasis. A randomized controlled trial.
summary: Main objective: To evaluate the effect of the combination of once-daily 7% hypertonic saline and twice-daily ELTGOL technique in mucus clearance in patients with bronchiectasis compared both to once-daily isotonic saline and twice-daily ELTGOL technique and to twice-daily ELTGOL technique on its own
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Men and woman ≥ 18 years old
2. Bronchiectasis confirmed by high resolution computed tomography
3. no exacerbations in the previous month
4. chronic purulent sputum (  ≥10ml daily expectoration)
5. at least one exacerbation in the previous year
6. FEV1 ≥30% after bronchodilation
7. sign the informed consent
Exclusion criteria:
1. patients > 85 years old
2. asthma, allergic bronchopulmonary aspergillosis or cystic fibrosis
3. current smokers or a smoking history of ≥20 pack/year
4. following mucoactive treatment in the previous month
5. contraindications to perform ELTGOL, spirometry or to attend visits
6. pulmonary rehabilitation in the previous 6 months
7. change of treatment the previous month
8. uncontrolled hypertension
